 Order

The learned counsel for the petitioner/applicant submits that the petitioner had filed a plea bargaining application before the learned Trial Court which was allowed and on his plea of guilt, he was convicted for the offences punishable under Section 379/411/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and order on sentence has been passed vide Order dated 18.11.2024 in CC No.CBI/61/2024.
2.

He further submits that vide the said Order, the learned Plea Bargaining Judge ordered the Petitioner to undergo imprisonment for a period of 142 days for commission of aforementioned offences along with payment of total compensation of Rs. 3,70,000/- inclusive of 9% interest per annum for 30 years and total fine of Rs. 10,000/-.
3.
The learned Counsel also submits that the Petitioner has paid the total fine of Rs. 10,000/-, and total compensation amounting to This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 30/06/2025 at 00:14:31 Rs. 3,70,000/- the UTR in respect of which has also been generated, which reflects in the aforementioned order dated 18.11.2024.
4. He submits that in view of the plea bargaining, since the matter has already been disposed of and nothing survives in the present bail application which has become infructuous.
5. In view of above, the present bail application stands disposed of being infructuous.
